node.name: 同步资产得分到 Supabase
node.definition: #1006 某资产得分变化即触发，只判断该资产当前是否在 total_heat 前 100。是则向 Supabase 新增或更新该资产；否则跳过。不补位、不遍历同步整个榜单，出榜旧行保留。无时间窗口、不写排名，尚未部署。
node.formula: 以本次变化的 asset_id + score_key 为候选，读取它的最新源分数；按完整精度分降序、asset_id 升序判断其是否前 100。符合则只 upsert 该资产，否则确认跳过。其他资产等自身得分变化再判断，不主动补齐 100 行。

requirements_zh: #1006 的得分变更立即触发，不设定时合并窗口或人为等待；通过可靠 CDC 或同事务 outbox 捕获并恢复变更。
本次通知的 asset_id + score_key 是唯一候选；先读取该键的最新 #1006 记录，再以 total_heat 完整精度分降序、asset_id 升序判断该资产是否前 100。可查询排名边界，但不得将其他榜单成员加入本次写入候选。
该变化资产在前 100 才执行 upsert；不存在则新增，已有且分数或名称变化则更新。榜外或源记录不存在则跳过。A 降榜不触发 B 补位；B 即使被动进入前 100，也等自身得分变化再处理。不要求凑足 100 条。
出榜资产不删除、不清零、不标记过期，保留此前得分和时间；当前前 100 仅限制本次写入候选，不限制 Supabase 总行数。源表为空时没有候选，也不清空目标。
source_version 是待实现的可靠来源版本，每个 asset_id + score_key 单调递增；不按跨资产通知到达顺序丢弃事件。同步控制记录按键保存已处理版本（含跳过），以事务防止旧任务覆盖新结果，目标行只在实际写入时更新版本。
失败保留通知并幂等重试，重启恢复未确认的资产变更，不扫描补齐完整前 100。重试重新读取该资产最新状态并判断；不丢处理期间产生的变化。仅时间戳或版本变更不单独触发数值同步。
calculated_at 保留本次被复制的得分时间，synced_at 为该行写入成功时间。不写 rank 字段，也不修改 #1006 或历史评分事件。
#3010 不判断展示有效期，不因过期删除或清零，也不为前端筛选等待。#1007 到前端的读取过滤另见 frontend_read；保持来源 calculated_at。
requirements_en: Process #1006 changes immediately with no fixed coalescing window or intentional delay. Capture changes recoverably via CDC or a transactional outbox.

Only asset_id + score_key from this change is eligible. Read its latest #1006 row, then check its position under full-precision total_heat descending and asset_id ascending. Ranking may read other rows, but they are never added as write candidates.

Upsert only if the changed asset is currently top 100: insert if missing or update a changed score/name. Skip outsiders and missing source rows. A decline never backfills B; even passive entrants wait for their own score change. No requirement to fill 100 slots.
Retain exits without deletion, zeroing or expiry flags. Top 100 limits write candidates, not total target rows. Empty source means no writes, not target truncation.

source_version is proposed reliable source metadata, monotonic per asset_id + score_key. Never discard another asset’s event based on cross-asset arrival order. Track processed versions per key, including skips, transactionally rejecting stale tasks; target row versions change only on writes.

Retry retained notifications idempotently and recover unacknowledged asset changes after restart, without a top-100 backfill scan. Re-read the asset’s latest state on retry; retain concurrent changes. Timestamp/version-only updates do not trigger score writes.
Preserve the copied score’s calculated_at and set synced_at on successful row writes. Store no rank and do not modify #1006 or score history.
#3010 never filters display freshness, deletes or zeros expired rows, or waits for frontend filtering. The #1007-to-frontend read contract is under frontend_read; preserve source calculated_at.

case.note_zh: 演算假设：另有 99 个资产得分高于 55 且不变，省略展示。KASUN 从 49 升至 55 进入前 100，目标若没有它就新增 55，已有则更新。Stake | Bonus 的 50 分旧行保留，不删除、不更新；目标此后可有 101 行。
case.note_en: Illustrative: 99 unchanged assets score above 55 and are omitted. KASUN rises from 49 to 55 into the top 100; insert 55 if missing, otherwise update it. Retain Stake | Bonus at its old 50 unchanged. The target can now contain 101 rows.

no_backfill.note_zh: 另 99 个资产得分更高。只有 A（Stake | Bonus）从 50 降到 45：A 现为第 101，跳过；B（KASUN）保持 49，虽被动成为第 100，本次也不写。等 B 自己变化，例如升到 55，再按上面的案例判断并写入。
no_backfill.note_en: 99 assets score higher. Only A (Stake | Bonus) falls from 50 to 45: it is now 101st, so skip. B (KASUN) stays at 49; though passively 100th, it is not written. Wait for B’s own change, such as rising to 55, then evaluate it as in the case above.

frontend_read.freshness_filter: calculated_at > query_time_utc - 180 seconds AND calculated_at <= query_time_utc
requirements_zh: 前端从 Supabase 查询 total_heat：先按可信 UTC 查询时刻筛选 calculated_at 在最近 180 秒内且不晚于当前时刻，再按 score_value 降序、asset_id 升序分页（首屏 20 为示例，最多 100）。3 分钟可配置，是展示有效期，不是同步窗口。边界达到 180 秒即过期；旧行仍存库，页面打开期间也须及时移除超时行。
重试写入不得用 synced_at 或当前时间替换 calculated_at 来续期；查询过滤必须在排序与 limit 之前，后续分页也应用新鲜度过滤。
上线前验证榜内每 60 秒真实重算后的持续同步能满足 180 秒展示有效期。数值不变而跳过写入、零分或同步故障都可能导致误隐藏；稳定分数的续期方式尚未选定，本次不擅自增加心跳写入。故障导致超时不代表已证实出榜，前端不能把数据陈旧当成资产删除。
requirements_en: Read total_heat from Supabase: first filter calculated_at within the last 180 seconds and not in the future at a trusted UTC query time, then order by score descending and asset ID ascending and paginate (20 initially is an example, up to 100). The configurable three minutes is display validity, not a sync window. Age >=180 seconds expires; retain stored rows and expire rows on already-open pages too.
Retries must not renew freshness by substituting synced_at or the current time for calculated_at. Apply freshness before ordering and limiting and on subsequent pages.

Before rollout, verify that ongoing delivery of genuine 60-second in-list recalculations satisfies the 180-second validity. Skipped unchanged values, zero scores and sync failures may falsely hide entries. Renewal for stable scores remains undecided; this change does not silently add heartbeat writes. Expiration indicates staleness, not proven exit or asset deletion.
